boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 149 is a Super Hard four-quadrant puzzle with a bottom micro-block tray and side rails at `27`/`30`. Each quadrant has its own counter that shrinks independently as tray pieces lock in. The left `20` quadrant feeds first, but a cyan `1` anchor and blue vertical `6` block guard the center — break the anchor too early and the `6` drifts into the right pocket, jamming two quadrants at once.
landmarks: Block Out Level 149 is a Super Hard four-quadrant puzzle with a bottom micro-block tray and side rails at `27`/`30`.
Each quadrant has its own counter that shrinks independently as tray pieces lock in.

The left `20` quadrant feeds first, but a cyan `1` anchor and blue vertical `6` block guard the center — break the anchor too early and the `6` drifts into the right pocket, jamming two quadrants at once.

quickTips: Break the yellow polyomino before moving the purple right-strip.
Keep the cyan 1 anchor intact until the left rail drops from 27 to 25.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Pull the bottom green vertical piece from the tray into the left 20 quadrant using the green left-arrow.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Break the cyan 1 tile in the center cluster without splitting the red floor bar.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Feed blue/yellow scraps into the right 23 quadrant once the left rail drops from 27 to 25.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Spend the bottom tray row — green, blue, yellow, purple — to drop the frame to 18/21/2/10.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Break the yellow polyomino in the center after the 2 and 10 bottom counters clear.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Clear the blue vertical 6 block to open the right 10 pocket.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Route the last purple strip through the red right-arrow lane for the glowing center clear.

failurePoints: Sliding the purple right-strip before the yellow polyomino breaks, sealing the red right-arrow lane.
Splitting the red floor bar while the cyan 1 tile is still locked, wasting the first tray feed.
